abilities.name: Root planting trial
abilities.function: Prepare a small soil patch and place one real root unit for a persistent observation trial; resume or cancel unfinished work.
abilities.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit; two work rounds at one energy each. Supply inputStackId and an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y patch within 0.65 plus body radius. Resume/cancel use personal processId (omitting it selects the sole unfinished job). No tools or water are granted.
abilities.effects: Preparation and exact escrow persist when other actions interrupt work. Resume pays only remaining work. Cancel releases surviving unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort and spoiled material are never refunded. Completed plots retain the real reserved root while existing environmental ageing runs. Reinspect with baseline probe: 30 elapsed rounds mark an inconclusive observation interval, not maturity or inferred death. There is no propagation, tending or harvest rule in this precursor, and no reward for placing it. Genuine observed changes can use existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback. Other people can observe the actual plot; execution requires personal study.

execution.progress: A disposable action cursor may end; the exact paid job and escrow persist. Two completed work rounds are required. Resume restores remaining work; cancellation/death settles once.

abilities.name: Assess a planted root
abilities.function: Record a planted-root baseline, observe, or physically uncover and cover an existing specimen while retaining actual progress and private evidence.
abilities.costs: Begin/observe: one round and 0.2 energy. Inspect: two paid work rounds, one energy each, no consumed root or tools. Only the creator may handle a plot; anyone may observe reachable public state. Provide target plot ID; resume/cancel can use exact personal processId.
abilities.effects: Begin records an external baseline and claims a personal work lock. Inspect uncovers the existing reserved root, records actual present condition, then replaces displaced soil. Interruption retains exposure and paid work; resume completes outstanding work only. Cancel/death releases the lock without automatically covering or refunding effort. Existing specimen ageing continues while unattended. Repeated unchanged observations and the 30-round checkpoint create no reward. No inferred germination, tending benefit, harvested food or biomass is supplied. Relevant dated physical changes may use the single existing grounded-understanding rule. Records remain personal until actual communication.

execution.progress: The job survives disposable cursor interruption. Remaining inspection rounds, exact plot, exposure and paid effort are retained; explicit cancel/death settles the lock once.

abilities.name: Examine a proposed soil worksite
abilities.function: Physically examine one reachable x/y footprint and report visible surface evidence plus provisional compatibility with the existing root-placement operation.
abilities.costs: One completed round and 0.5 energy after valid visible reach and bounds checks. No material, tools, plot or reservation. Invalid invocations do not begin or charge. A later new examination pays again.
abilities.effects: Private dated surface/clearance findings identify operation limitations separately from unknown physical properties. Bare ground is distinct from the general ordinary-soil moisture regime. No deeper substrate, concealed occupant or hidden resource information. No clearing, excavation, sampling, planting, material change, skill grant, food or reward. The atomic attempt has no resumable work or maintenance; no unperformed completion is recorded. Results are not silently refreshed and sharing requires real communication.

execution.progress: One atomic paid examination; no escrow, ongoing labor or automatic retry. A cancelled pre-execution intention does not become a completed observation.

abilities.name: Prepare a small soil patch
abilities.function: Examine one nominated radius-0.2 footprint, then attempt at most two rounds of manual loose-cover displacement, conserving debris inside the original boundary.
abilities.costs: Fresh start: one round and 0.5 energy for feasibility. Up to two additional work rounds cost one energy each. Radius is fixed at 0.2; x/y bind the job and cannot be substituted. No tool, root, water, food or inventory material is given or consumed.
abilities.effects: Supports explicitly modeled loose forest-floor cover only. Each supported footprint begins with finite 0.04 cover mass units, with hand capacity 0.02 per work round. All displaced matter remains non-food non-harvestable residue inside the boundary. Repeated attempts reuse actual remaining cover/residues, never reset quantities. Partial changes persist; cancel/death closes only the work lock, without restoration or refund. Entire-footprint root eligibility remains false while any cover or residue remains; exhausting work does not prove suitable soil. No unattended work, regrowth suppression, planting, food, moisture/fertility improvement or reward. Study and surface changes are separate.

execution.progress: Exact personal process ID, footprint, paid rounds, original cover and residues persist. Resume pays outstanding rounds only. Final/blocked attempts close their transient lock.

abilities.name: Loose moss resting trial
abilities.function: Place owned moss, inspect the resulting arrangement or perform a real ground-supported contact/rest trial.
abilities.costs: Quote: retrieve this ability through the free control abilities query; reading these exact terms takes no world round. Begin requires inputStackId, quantity 0.1–2 in tenths, x/y and radius 0.1–0.5, two actual rounds at 1 energy each. Study costs two rounds at 0.2 energy. Inspect requires arrangementId, one round/0.2 energy. Rest-trial requires arrangementId and actual contact position, one baseline rest round, with existing mental/facility factors and cap40. Resume/cancel use exact processId. Additional placement on an owned unlocked arrangement repeats the same costs and exact footprint.
abilities.effects: First step places actual reserved moss at the site; second spreads actual tenths within the nominated radius, without mass-to-volume or coverage inference. Placed ground material is recoverable with recover(arrangementId), one round/0.5 energy for actual reachable surviving portions; this scoped pickup supports tenths that baseline whole-unit pickup cannot. Recovery removes material from the arrangement. Cancel/death preserve placed material and paid work; no refund or automatic labor. Rest measures real geometric contact and at most0.02 lateral displacement of contacted loose material inside the footprint; no inferred load strength, thickness, comfort, durability or recovery bonus. Usability remains inconclusive. Personal findings are not publicly shared. No reward, regeneration, binding, tool or stock grant.

execution.progress: Exact process, source portions, paid rounds and placed ground material persist; resume only outstanding work. Quote is a read-only control query, not a physical action.

abilities.name: Bounded surface residue transfer
abilities.function: Examine and manually displace actual prepared-surface residue to an explicitly selected adjacent receiver.
abilities.costs: Study one round/0.2 energy. Start(sourceId,destinationX,destinationY) examines one round/0.5 energy, then at most two1-energy rounds moving0.02 each, up to actual0.04. Version bound to original surface-21-lin-113 and its creator; both centers and moved portions within0.65 of the actor. Receiver radius0.1, center separation from source greater than0.3 and at most0.5, entirely in bounds. Resume/cancel exact processId; no material/tool/container supplied.
abilities.effects: Exact hundredth mass accounting and source-entry provenance. Each atomic transfer requires a swept-radius clear visible ground route excluding people, plants, obstacles and unrelated reservations. Invalid references/range cost nothing; performed blocked examination costs0.5. Changed route pauses before charges. Deposits persist as nonfood, nonharvestable matter, never inventory. Cancel/death release only locks, preserving all movement and spent effort. No unattended work, restoration, reward, fertility, food, moisture or planting certification. Repeated starts inspect live remaining mass, never reset it.

execution.progress: Exact source revision, entry routes, receiver, work ID, allowance, paid progress and deposits persist; resume never resets allowance.
